planets.name: K2-110 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-110 with a 13.9-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: K2-110 b was found in 2017 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-110. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
